strings.title: Teacher
strings.signedOut: Sign in to build your courses.
strings.startBody: Give it a title — you can add sections and lessons right after.
strings.pickBody: Pick a course on the left to edit its curriculum and details, or start a new one.
strings.publishEmpty: Add at least one lesson before publishing.
strings.unpublishBody: It goes back to draft and leaves the catalog. You can publish it again any time.
strings.restoreBody: Bring the course back as a draft so you can edit and publish it again.
strings.archiveBody: Take the course out of the catalog and your active list. Nothing is deleted.
strings.dragHint: Drag ⋮⋮ to reorder (or focus it and use ↑ ↓). Click a title to rename it.
strings.deleteSectionBody: Its {lessons} and their content, checkpoints and learner progress are deleted too. This can't be undone.
strings.noLessons: No lessons in this section yet.
strings.newLessonPlaceholder: Lesson title — press Return to add
strings.previewHint: Free preview lessons can be watched before enrolling.
strings.deleteLessonBody: Its content, checkpoints and every learner's progress in it are deleted ({learners} in this course). This can't be undone.
strings.reorderSection: Reorder section {title}: drag, or use the arrow keys
strings.reorderLesson: Reorder lesson {title}: drag, or use the arrow keys
strings.emptyCourseBody: Sections are like chapters: group your lessons into them. Start with one.
strings.fSubtitleHint: One line under the title in the catalog.
strings.fSlugHint: Changing it breaks links already shared.
strings.fCoverHint: Link to an image (16:9 works best).
strings.addTag: Add a tag and press Return
strings.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes for the URL.
strings.deleteBody: Deletes the course, its sections, lessons and every learner's enrollment and progress.
strings.deleteCourseBody: {lessons} and {learners}' enrollments and progress are deleted. This can't be undone.
strings.newCourseBody: It starts as a draft: only you and your team see it until you publish.
strings.errSignedOut: you're not signed in — sign in to edit
strings.errNoRole: you need to be an owner, admin or instructor of this business to do that
strings.errSlugTaken: that course URL is already taken
strings.fixFirst: Fix {n} things before saving — they're listed at the top.
strings.discardBody: This lesson has changes you haven't saved.
strings.contentHint: What learners read, top to bottom. Bold and term links are the inline styles the Classroom shows.
strings.noBlocks: No content yet. Add a paragraph, heading, pull quote, figure or worked example below.
strings.noTerms: There are no terms yet. Add one, then link it.
strings.captionPlaceholder: Caption (optional — the figure's own caption is used otherwise)
strings.labelPlaceholder: Label (optional — the example's title is used otherwise)
strings.gatedHint: Gated blocks stay hidden until the segment before them is complete.
strings.reorderBlock: Reorder block {n} ({kind}): drag, or use the arrow keys
strings.materialsHint: Terms, figures, worked examples and notes, shared by every lesson in this course. Saved as soon as you add or edit them.
strings.deleteMaterialBody: It's removed from the course. This can't be undone.
strings.deleteMaterialUsed: {n} block(s) in this lesson use it and will show nothing until you pick another. This can't be undone.
strings.svgHint: Paste SVG markup. Scripts and outside links are removed when it's shown.
strings.videoHint: Learners watch this video. Segments and checkpoints run on its timeline.
strings.dropHint: Drop a file here, or choose one.
strings.uploadUnavailable: Uploading isn't switched on yet: the video service that creates the upload isn't deployed. You can attach a video that's already in the library by its ID.
strings.uploaded: Video uploaded. It may take a few minutes to process.
strings.errUploadUrl: the video host didn't return an upload address
strings.errUploadStalled: the video host stopped accepting the file
strings.videoIdInvalid: That isn't a video ID. It looks like 3f1c2a9e-…, 36 characters.
strings.audioHint: A link to the audio file learners play.
strings.mediaLinkHint: Optional: a direct link to a media file, used when the lesson has no library video.
strings.segmentsHintTime: Split the lesson's timeline into parts learners finish in order (lesson length {length}). Add a checkpoint quiz to any part.
strings.segmentsHintPara: Split the article into parts by paragraph (it has {n}). Learners finish them in order; add a checkpoint quiz to any part.
strings.noSegments: No segments: the whole lesson is one part.
strings.reorderSegment: Reorder segment {n}: drag, or use the arrow keys
strings.revealAnswers: Show the right answers after an attempt
strings.blocksProgressHint: The next segment stays locked until the learner passes.
strings.reorderQuestion: Reorder question {n}: drag, or use the arrow keys
strings.textExact: Graded as an exact match, including capitals.
strings.notInClassroom: The Classroom can't show this type to learners yet
strings.passMarkHint: The share of points needed to pass.
strings.shuffleHint: Each learner sees the options in their own order.
strings.revealHint: After submitting, learners see which answers were right.
strings.lessonTypeHint: Changing it changes what the lesson shows and how segments are measured.
strings.completeAtHint: How much a learner must watch or read for the lesson to count as done.
strings.gatesNext: Lock the next lesson until this one is done
strings.gatesNextHint: Applies when the course unlocks lessons in order.
strings.showSegmentsHint: Learners see the lesson's parts and where they are.
strings.pNoMaterial: Block {n} needs a figure or example chosen.
strings.pTimeRange: {at}: its end must come after its start.
strings.pParaRange: {at}: paragraphs must run from 1 to {n}, with the end after the start.
strings.pPassMark: {at}: the pass mark must be between 1 and 100.
strings.pAttempts: {at}: attempts must be 1 or more, or left empty.
strings.pExamEmpty: The quiz has no questions yet.
strings.priceHint: What a learner pays to enroll.
strings.priceRequired: Enter a price above zero, or choose Free.
strings.credentialHint: Learners type this code to enroll.
strings.credentialKeep: Leave empty to keep the current code, or type a new one.
strings.credentialRequired: Enter the access code learners will use.
strings.channelHint: The channel the course appears under.
strings.noChannels: This business has no channels yet.
strings.flagsPartial: Add a lesson to see and change the rest of these settings: the store reports them with a lesson.
strings.couponsGap: Coupons and discount codes aren't available yet: the store has no place for them.
strings.addStudentBody: Enrolls the member in “{course}” for free. They'll find it in their Classroom.
strings.pauseBody: They keep their progress but can't open the course until you restore it.
strings.rosterGap: Learners show as member numbers, and paused access isn't shown until you change it here: the store's class list doesn't include names or pauses yet.
strings.funnelHint: Everyone enrolled (not counting dropped), by how much of the course they've finished.
strings.lessonsHint: Views count learners who pressed play. Choose a lesson to see where learners stop inside it.
strings.noSegmentsData: This lesson has no segments to measure.
strings.insightsGap: Per-lesson completion counts and revenue aren't reported by the store yet.
strings.replyPlaceholder: Write a reply as the instructor…
strings.commentsGap: You can't remove a learner's comment from here yet: the store only lets people delete their own.
strings.certHint: Learners get a certificate with a serial number when they complete the course.
strings.certUnknownNote: The store doesn't report this setting yet, so it shows here once you set it. New courses start with it on.
strings.pathsBody: Paths bundle several courses into one certificate. The store can show and issue them, but it can't create or edit them yet, so they're set up by the platform for now.

access.label: Open
access.hint: Anyone who can see the course can enroll (and pay, if it has a price).

access.label: Invite only
access.hint: Only learners you add from Students can take the course.

access.label: Access code
access.hint: Learners enter a code you share with them to enroll.

course_flags.label: Lessons unlock in order
course_flags.hint: A learner finishes each lesson before the next one opens.

course_flags.label: Let learners skip ahead
course_flags.hint: Every segment and lesson stays open, even when order is on.

course_flags.label: Show the discussion
course_flags.hint: Comments appear under each lesson that allows them.

course_flags.label: Show transcripts
course_flags.hint: Learners can read along with a video's transcript.

course_flags.label: Play the next lesson automatically
course_flags.hint: When a video ends, the next lesson starts.
